narrative.overview:
Inventium is drawn as process-control instrumentation. A roaster does not read a number card; they read the actual probe trace against the envelope the batch was meant to stay inside, and they can see in one mark whether the process is in control. Every quantity that moves in this product is drawn the same way: the actual reading in probe amber, the target or reference band in envelope teal, the moment the reading left the band in breach red. The interface refuses the category's arrangement of same-size KPI cards over a generic line chart, where the figure and its limit never appear in the same mark.

The surface is instrument-flat. A slate-teal rail holds the left edge as one unbroken field; the work area is technical white, never cream. Hairlines divide, nothing is rounded past 2px, and there is no gradient, no glass, no glow. Depth exists only as a faint offset shadow on genuinely floating things (dropdowns, tooltips, datepickers); the panels themselves sit on the ground and are bounded by a single hairline. Density is high and deliberately so: the reader is checking many lines at once, at a desk, on a counter tablet under bright overhead light, and on a warehouse floor with glare. Light is the primary theme for that reason, chosen from the use scene rather than from category habit; dark is fully designed and grounded on near-black #081012.

Type does two jobs and never confuses them. Chivo carries the interface and the monumental tabular figures; Chivo Mono carries measurement only — SKUs, units, axis labels, counts, timestamps, state words. Mono is never decoration. The honesty of the figures is part of the visual system, not a copy concern: where a value does not exist in the backend, the surface says so in the same small tracked caps it uses for every other label rather than drawing a plausible band or a currency figure nobody earned.
keyCharacteristics: One encoding for every changing quantity: amber actual, teal band, red crossing.
Instrument-flat surfaces, device-pixel hairlines, nothing rounded past 2px.
Chivo for interface and monumental figures, Chivo Mono for measurement only.
Technical-white ground under a flat slate-teal rail; light theme primary.
Honest absence: no par, no price, no count unless the service answered.

rules.name: The Three Signals Rule
rules.body: Amber is the reading, teal is the target, red is the crossing. A colour never changes job between surfaces, and no fourth signal colour is introduced for emphasis.

rules.name: The Off, Not Alarmed Rule
rules.body: A record that is out of play desaturates to #8a979c on a transparent field. It never takes a coloured badge. Out of stock is a breach and stays breach red — never desaturated.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No gradient, no glass, no coloured halo, no glow. A tint is a flat fill at a stated opacity (13% for a band, 3–6% for a dark-theme surface) or it is not drawn.

rules.name: The Measurement-Only Rule
rules.body: Chivo Mono is for things a device could have measured: figures, units, codes, axis labels, state words, timestamps. It is never used for a sentence, a heading, or decoration.

rules.name: The Figures Line Up Rule
rules.body: Every numeric column is tabular (tnum) and right-aligned, with its unit set smaller and in muted ink beside it. Tables carry font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums at the element level so this holds even where a cell forgets.

rules.name: The Priority Step-Aside Rule
rules.body: Dense tables do not scroll sideways to stay whole; columns leave by priority as width is lost. The inventory row sheds Updated below 1280, Category and Location below 1024, and ID and the secondary actions below 640 — at 390px it keeps name, quantity, state (moved under the name), level and one action. The actions cell is sticky-right from 640 up.

rules.name: The Band Owns Its Region Rule
rules.body: The signature trace gets a full region bounded by one hairline, with its figure set inside it. No card inside a card, no frame inside a frame.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: If an element is in the page flow, it gets a hairline and no shadow. A shadow is a statement that the element is floating above the page, and nothing in the flow is.

rules.name: The 2px Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Nothing is rounded past 2px. No pills, no capsules, no fully-rounded chips anywhere a state or a figure is shown.

dos: Do draw every changing quantity as the envelope trace: amber actual, teal band at 13% fill with hairline bounds, breach red at the crossing.
Do keep Chivo Mono for measurement — figures, units, SKUs, axis labels, state words, counts — and set it small with heavy tracking.
Do bound panels with a single #cbd6da hairline on the technical-white ground and leave them flat.
Do right-align numeric columns as tabular figures with the unit smaller and muted beside them.
Do label an absence in the same tracked caps as any other label: "No target set", "no par set", "stock service unreachable", an em-dash instead of a figure.
Do let columns step aside by priority as width is lost, keeping name, quantity, state, level and one action at 390px.
Do design both themes: dark grounds on #081012 with panels as white at 3%.
donts: Don't round anything past 2px, and never ship a pill or capsule for a state.
Don't use a gradient, a glass blur, a coloured glow, or a shadow on anything sitting in the page flow.
Don't reassign the signal colours: amber is never decoration, teal is never a generic accent, red is never emphasis.
Don't desaturate an out-of-stock line — out of stock is a breach and stays breach red. Desaturation means switched off.
Don't draw a target band where no target exists, derive a money figure where the service returns no price, or show a count a service did not answer with.
Don't put a same-size KPI card grid over a generic line chart; the figure and its limit belong in the same mark.
Don't set body copy, headings or navigation labels in the mono face.
